integrity: The prior sharp inequality, simplex volume identity and small common-shift concept are explicitly credited; only the exhaustive if-and-only-if equality classification is asserted as new. Analytical proof and rational verification included; no independent external review performed.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional full-dimensional zonotopes with at most four generators; complete equality locus, not a classification of higher-dimensional or more-generator bodies. Historical priority for the exhaustive classification remains provisional.
title: Complete equality family for the circumradius–volume inequality of four-generator spatial zonotopes
